message: Forward-integrated landing satisfies the configured numerical and DEM-model checks. This is not NASA certification.

terrain.sampling: Powered: ≤120m path spacing and ≤0.5s. Coast: ≤2s. Validation is against the supplied DEM model; unresolved hazards are excluded.

continuity.method: One continuous seven-state forward propagation; DOI velocity and rocket-equation mass impulse only.

reference.time: UTC input; seconds from flight start; SPICE-precomputed orientation interpolation
reference.optimizer: 3D six-moment shooting over 24 piecewise constant acceleration segments; 48 duration/heading/phase starts
reference.integrator: Seven-state RK4; independently refined endpoint and dense DEM checks

warnings: Two-body central gravity; no nonspherical gravity, third bodies, engine slew limits, plume or hazard certification.
DOI is an ideal impulse. Its propellant and minimum full-thrust burn-time estimate are reported; finite-burn DOI is not simulated.
Terrain checks use the supplied 240m south-polar DEM and a coarse global high-altitude model. They do not resolve rocks or subpixel slopes.
Fuel/time ranking is over a bounded candidate family; no globally optimal solution is claimed.
